description: Implement the actual gameplay: a Phaser 3 arena battle scene where the player controls their chosen champion against an AI-controlled enemy champion in a single-lane LoL-style arena. Includes movement, basic attacks, four abilities with cooldowns, health/mana/resource bars, damage/combat resolution, periodic minion waves and a defensive turret per side, a simple but reactive enemy bot AI, and win/lose detection when a Nexus/champion is defeated. Core combat math and AI decisions are implemented as pure, unit-tested TypeScript separate from Phaser rendering. Depends on FEAT-002.
steps: Create src/game/combat.ts (pure TS, no Phaser import): entity types (Unit with hp, maxHp, ad, armor, position), damage calculation (e.g., effective damage after armor), cooldown tracking helper, ability resolution given an ability behavior tag and target(s). Keep it deterministic and unit-testable.

Create src/game/ai.ts (pure TS): a decideAction(state) function for the enemy champion returning an intent ('approach' | 'attack' | 'castQ'|'castW'|'castE'|'castR' | 'retreat') based on distances, cooldowns, hp thresholds. Deterministic given inputs so it can be unit tested.

Create src/game/PhaserGame.tsx: a React component that instantiates a Phaser.Game into a container div on mount and destroys it on unmount, passing the selected player/enemy champion ids and an onGameEnd(result) callback into the scene via the scene's init data or registry. Handle React StrictMode double-mount safely.

Create src/game/scenes/BattleScene.ts: a Phaser.Scene rendering a stylized single lane (base/nexus at each end, a turret per side, spawn points). Player champion is keyboard/mouse controlled (WASD or click-to-move for movement; Q/W/E/R keys to cast abilities aimed at cursor; left/right click for basic attack/move). Draw units with Phaser graphics/shapes + text (no external art dependency) styled to the champion's theme color. Render floating damage numbers and ability effects (projectiles, dashes, AoE circles).

Implement periodic minion waves spawning from each base that walk down the lane and auto-fight, and a turret that attacks the nearest enemy in range - classic MOBA lane feel. Reuse combat.ts for all damage.
Drive the enemy champion each update tick via ai.ts decideAction and apply the resulting intent through the same ability/combat systems the player uses.
Implement win/lose: destroying the enemy Nexus (or reducing enemy champion+base) wins; losing yours loses. Call onGameEnd with { win: boolean, stats } to hand control back to React.

Create an in-battle HUD (React overlay or Phaser DOM): champion health/resource bars, four ability icons showing cooldown state, and a small localized objective/help line. Prefer a React overlay (AbilityCard/ChampionCard reuse) positioned over the canvas, reading live state via a shared store or Phaser events; keep all text localized.
Wire BattleScreen React component (src/screens/BattleScreen.tsx) that hosts PhaserGame + HUD overlay and, on game end, routes to the results screen with the outcome.

Add unit tests: src/game/combat.test.ts (armor reduces damage correctly, lethal damage kills a unit, cooldowns block recasting until elapsed, ability resolution applies expected damage/heal per behavior tag) and src/game/ai.test.ts (bot retreats at low hp, casts an available ability when in range, approaches when out of range). These must exercise real logic and fail if the formulas/AI are reverted.
acceptance_criteria: combat.ts and ai.ts are Phaser-free and fully unit tested; combat.test.ts and ai.test.ts pass and meaningfully assert the damage/cooldown/AI behavior.
BattleScene compiles and PhaserGame mounts/unmounts cleanly (no double-instance leak under StrictMode).
Player can move, basic attack, and cast Q/W/E/R with visible cooldowns; enemy bot acts via ai.ts; minions and a turret per side exist.
Game reaches a win or lose end state that invokes onGameEnd and returns to React.
npm run test -- --run, npx tsc --noEmit, and npm run build all pass.
findings:
Implemented full FEAT-003 gameplay. Verification: `npm run test -- --run` (65 tests, 6 files pass), `npx tsc --noEmit` clean, `npm run build` succeeds with base '/game-champs/' (Phaser code-split into its own PhaserGame chunk). Files created: src/game/combat.ts, src/game/ai.ts, src/game/combat.test.ts (22 tests), src/game/ai.test.ts (12 tests), src/game/battleStore.ts, src/game/PhaserGame.tsx, src/game/BattleHud.tsx, src/game/scenes/BattleScene.ts, src/screens/BattleScreen.tsx, src/screens/ResultScreen.tsx. Modified: src/App.tsx (wired battle+result screens, holds BattleOutcome state), src/i18n/locales/{ko,en}.json (added battle.* and result.* keys, key parity preserved), src/styles/global.css (battle/HUD/result CSS).

COMBAT API (src/game/combat.ts, Phaser-free): Vec2, Team ('ally'|'enemy'), UnitKind ('champion'|'minion'|'turret'|'nexus'), Unit (id,kind,team,pos,hp,maxHp,ad,armor,attackRange,attackSpeed,moveSpeed,attackCdRemaining,dead). Functions: distance, inRange, effectiveDamage(raw,armor) using MOBA curve 100/(100+armor) (neg armor amplifies), applyDamage->{dealt,lethal} (mutates+sets dead), applyHeal (clamped, no dead), CooldownState {Q,W,E,R} + createCooldownState/isReady/startCooldown/tickCooldowns/cooldownProgress, resolveAbility(ability)->AbilityEffect {behavior,damage,heal,stunDuration,buffDuration,dashes,area,radius} per behavior tag, nearestEnemy(from,units,maxRange), stepToward.

AI API (src/game/ai.ts, Phaser-free): decideAction(AiSnapshot)->AiIntent ('approach'|'attack'|'castQ/W/E/R'|'retreat'). Snapshot has selfHpPct, selfResourcePct, distanceToTarget, hasTarget, attackRange, cooldowns, abilityRanges/abilityCosts per slot, maxResource, targetLowHp. Priority: no target->approach; hp<=RETREAT_HP_THRESHOLD(0.28) && !execute->retreat; cast highest-impact ready+affordable+in-range ability (R>W>Q>E); attack if in range; else approach. canCast helper exported.

onGameEnd/outcome flow: BattleScene calls onGameEnd(BattleOutcome) via scene init data when a Nexus dies. BattleOutcome {win, playerChampionId, enemyChampionId, stats:{durationSeconds,championKills,minionKills,damageDealt}} lives in src/game/battleStore.ts. PhaserGame.tsx passes onGameEnd into scene.init and guards a single Phaser.Game instance (gameRef) so React StrictMode double-mount is safe; destroys on unmount. Live HUD data flows scene->battleStore (BattleHudState) and BattleHud.tsx reads it via useSyncExternalStore (no React<->Phaser coupling). App.tsx stores the outcome and routes 'battle'->'result'. BattleScreen lazy-loads PhaserGame (React.lazy + Suspense) so Phaser never enters the unit-test/App module graph; combat.ts and ai.ts stay Phaser-free.

NOTES FOR FEAT-004: ResultScreen.tsx is a MINIMAL handoff (victory/defeat banner, matchup, 4 stats, Rematch/Main Menu buttons) using result.* i18n keys and result-screen CSS - expand it into the full results screen. Rematch is wired in App.handleRematch (re-enters 'battle' with same match; PhaserGame recreates on id change but NOT on rematch of same ids - FEAT-004 may need a match nonce/key to force scene restart on identical-champion rematch). No audio yet. Champions currently respawn after 6s to keep the match flowing toward a Nexus win; tune balance/polish (VFX, camera, sound) in FEAT-004. Player resource is a generic 300 pool with regen 8/s. All new user-facing strings are in both ko/en (i18n parity test passes).
